(as in 來世|来世[lai2 shi4]); (between two verbs) in order to; (after a round number) approximately; (used after 得[de2] to indicate possibility, as in 談得來|谈得来[tan2 de5 lai2], or after 不[bu4] to indicate impossibility, as in 吃不來|吃不来[chi1 bu5 lai2])

到.english: to reach; to arrive; to leave for; to go to; to (a place); until (a time); up to (a point); (verb complement indicating arriving at a place or reaching a point); considerate; thoughtful; thorough

動.english: (of sth) to move; to set in movement; to displace; to touch; to make use of; to stir (emotions); to alter; abbr. for 動詞|动词[dong4 ci2], verb

修.english: surname Xiu; to decorate; to embellish; to repair; to build; to write; to cultivate; to study; to take (a class)

也.english: surname Ye; also; too; as well; (not ...) either; (used after a verbal or nominal expression X to indicate that X is an extreme or unexpected case) even (X); (literary) particle having functions similar to 啊[a5]

立.english: surname Li; to stand; to set up; to establish; to lay down; to draw up; at once; immediately

準.english: accurate; standard; definitely; certainly; about to become (bride, son-in-law etc); quasi-; para-

成.english: surname Cheng; short name for Chengdu 成都[Cheng2 du1]; to succeed; to finish; to complete; to accomplish; to become; to turn into; to be all right; OK!; one tenth

明.english: Ming Dynasty (1368–1644); surname Ming; Ming (c. 2000 BC), fourth of the legendary Flame Emperors, 炎帝[Yan2 di4] descended from Shennong 神農|神农[Shen2 nong2] Farmer God; bright; opposite: dark 暗[an4]; (of meaning) clear; to understand; next; public or open; wise; generic term for a sacrifice to the gods

亞.english: Asia; Asian; Taiwan pr. [Ya3]; second; next to; inferior; sub-; Taiwan pr. [ya3]

件.english: item; component; classifier for events, things, clothes etc

詩.english: abbr. for Shijing 詩經|诗经[Shi1 jing1], the Book of Songs; poem; CL:首[shou3]; poetry; verse

訓.english: to teach; to train; to admonish; (bound form) instruction (from superiors); teachings; rule

備.english: (bound form) to prepare; to equip; (literary) fully; completely

門.english: surname Men; gate; door; doorway; gateway; opening (CL:扇[shan4]); valve; switch; other door-like or gate-like structure; way to do sth; knack; method; approach; family; household; lineage; (bound form) sect; school; faction (religious or academic); (bound form) class; category; division; phylum; classifier for courses, fields of study, branches of technology, relatives by marriage, guns etc; (suffix) -gate (scandal)

荒.english: desolate; shortage; scarce; out of practice; absurd; uncultivated; to neglect

接.english: to receive; to answer (the phone); to meet or welcome sb; to connect; to catch; to join; to extend; to take one's turn on duty; to take over for sb

香.english: fragrant; sweet smelling; aromatic; savory or appetizing; (to eat) with relish; (of sleep) sound; perfume or spice; joss or incense stick; CL:根[gen1]

前.english: front; forward; ahead; first; top (followed by a number); future; ago; before; BC (e.g. 前293年); former; formerly

釋.english: to explain; to release; Buddha (abbr. for 釋迦牟尼|释迦牟尼[Shi4 jia1 mou2 ni2]); Buddhism

今.english: now; the present time; current; contemporary; this (day, year etc)

由.english: to follow; from; because of; due to; by; via; through; (before a noun and a verb) it is for ... to ...

當時.english: then; at that time; immediately; right then

發生.english: to happen; to occur; to take place; to arise (e.g. 發生問題|发生问题[fa1 sheng1 wen4 ti2] "a problem arises")

得到.english: to get; to obtain; to receive

改成.english: to convert; to turn into (sth else); to adapt (a story to another medium)

房子.english: house; building (single- or two-story); apartment; room; CL:棟|栋[dong4],幢[zhuang4],座[zuo4],套[tao4],間|间[jian1]

開放.english: to bloom; to open; to be open (to the public); to open up (to the outside); to be open-minded; unrestrained by convention; unconstrained in one's sexuality

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if ... (that one can ...) (as in 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only (someone) who ... (as in 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to express lack of alternatives) can only; have no choice but to (as in 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")

到得.english: to arrive at (some place or time)

需要.english: to need; to want; to demand; to require; needs

小金.english: see 小金縣|小金县[Xiao3 jin1 Xian4]

就是.english: exactly; precisely; only; simply; just; (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if

沒有.english: haven't; hasn't; doesn't exist; to not have; to not be

一套.english: suit; a set; a collection; of the same kind; the same old stuff; set pattern of behavior

一路.english: the whole journey; all the way; going the same way; going in the same direction; of the same kind
